label: flipThenTurn: the flip is composed on the wrong side, before this value's turns
find: public func flipped(_ d: FlipDirection) -> Orientation { then(d == .horizontal ? .upMirrored : .downMirrored) }
replace: public func flipped(_ d: FlipDirection) -> Orientation { (d == .horizontal ? Orientation.upMirrored : .downMirrored).then(self) }

label: sizeSwaps: an odd number of turns keeps the image's sides
mirrorReversesTurns: a mirror after a turn keeps the turn's direction
